{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Aeolus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Aeolus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores [[Anemos]] and {{MCW|Wind Burst}} I. It is the only craftable source of Anemos, and is crafted from seven {{MCW|Wind Charge|wind charges}} and a {{MCW|Block of Gold|block of gold}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/wind_burst_anemos.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Aeolus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Aeolus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Anemos applies to swords and sticks, while Wind Burst applies only to {{MCW|Mace|maces}}, so no single item can use both enchantments from one book. Anemos is forbidden on maces. Applying the book to a sword gives Anemos; applying it to a mace gives Wind Burst.

== Trivia ==
* Aeolus is the keeper of the winds in Greek mythology, matching the wind charges in the recipe and the wind-based enchantments.
